correctness.rationale: For every strict divisibility chain, the Lagrange coefficients alternate in sign. Writing b_k=|c_k|h_k, the exact adjacent ratio is bounded below by 2 times a finite product of (1-4^{-m}), hence exceeds 4/3 after the first level. Each collected nested-grid weight is therefore a positive alternating tail in strictly increasing magnitudes. The exact maximum is b_d and constant exactness gives the optimal sample-noise norm. Exact-rational replay corroborates 124 variable chains and the stated boundary example.
